White, near white or white blend Floribunda.
Registration name: Strawberry Ice
Exhibition name: Strawberry Ice
rows.Origin:
Bred by G. Delbard (France, before 1971).
Introduced in France by Delbard/Georges Delbard SA in 1973 as 'Bordure Rose'.
Introduced in United Kingdom by Bees of Chester / Sealand Nurseries Ltd. in 1975 as 'Bordure Rose'.
rows.Bloom: Cream, pink edges. None / no fragrance. Medium to large, double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, in small clusters, cupped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Short, dense. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 3' (90cm). Width: 2' (60cm).
rows.Growing: Can be used for beds and borders, container rose or ground cover. Very hardy. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
